reviewer: Codex assistant visual review; not independent human adjudication
masking: Image-only observations saved first. Candidate names and reference captions hidden during rankings; blind_key.json not opened before saving this file.
criterion: Factual precision and coverage of clearly visible changes; ignore wording. Ties include equally flawed captions. Rank tiers best first. Uncertain object identity/occlusion is not a confirmed error.

cases.evidence: All cover cushion, goose and extra stool. Candidates 1/3 additionally assert a left stool moved right, unsupported by the views. Goose is across ottoman/table, not solely table; cushion shape omitted by all.
Candidates 1/2 capture side bend and overhead arm. All mislocate previous hands at chest. Candidate 3 adds incompatible new arm positions and lean direction.

All identify pose change but incorrectly describe new pose as lying flat/on ground rather than standing wide-legged forward bend, and misdescribe hand/foot contact. Limb laterality too uncertain for preference.
All identify cushion color but falsely replace gray ottoman with goose: ottoman remains underneath. Equivalent substantive errors.
All identify inversion but misdescribe previous supported one-leg balance and new split/bent leg geometry as both straight. Equivalent substantive errors.
All identify mouse entering opening; all assert fewer food pieces though camera angle/framing changes prevent reliable quantity comparison. No meaningful precision preference.

Clear jar forward movement and newly visible red/black thermos missed. Candidate 1 incorrectly claims bottle swapping/turning; 2/3 incorrectly claim color replacement and disappearance of still-visible green-lid jar. None materially adequate; no defensible clear ranking.
All capture lifted leg but describe both initial arms as overhead and misdescribe final rear arm; miss conspicuous changed background/framing. Anatomy is ambiguous; no clear factual advantage.
All falsely remove visible flowers and misidentify red bed-end panel as table/lamp. All miss changed wall picture. Equivalent major object confusions.

Bike shifts/rotates toward right curb/bucket. Candidates 1/3 capture direction although initial middle-of-road phrasing overstates it. Candidate 2 reverses movement toward road center. All omit rotation.

Candidate 2 identifies new round pastry and appropriate position. Candidates 1/3 call it cookies; 3 also invents two baskets. All invent chair changes and miss rock plus narrower waterfall. Relative preference only; none fully correct.

True clear change is rear monitor rotation; keyboards/adjacent chairs unchanged in close view. All invent keyboard/chair changes; candidate 3 adds unsupported trash-can disappearance. Candidates 1/2 tied despite different wrong chair directions.

All incorrectly move table/chairs and miss white-to-purple watering-can appearance/location change. Other asserted plants/hose/pot changes unsupported. None adequate; no reliable preference from speculative small details.
All identify brightness increase and invent unsupported chair movement. Equivalent semantics despite wording.
Identical captions locate added yellow item correctly but misidentify folding caution sign as mop bucket.

All identify added yellow item but call sign a mop bucket. All mislocate bicycle end position; candidate 3 center-of-road is less wrong than left side near red house in 1/2. True bike rotates/moves toward right curb; none fully correct.

limitations: 16 correlated pairs, eight per domain. Assistant assessment only, no independent human gold or inter-rater reliability. Relative wins do not imply captions are correct. Aggregate cached-A10 preliminary scores were previously seen; candidate-model mapping remained hidden.
